        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 57 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref3_italy = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_57 >= 35 } # R57 伦巴第—利古里亚 35/70
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 58 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref3_sicily = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_58 >= 12 } # R58 西西里 12/23
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 59 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref3_sardinia = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_59 >= 16 } # R59 撒丁—科西嘉 16/31
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 60 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref3_raetia = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_60 >= 33 } # R60 拉埃提亚—赫尔维蒂 33/66
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 61 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref3_africa_core = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_61 >= 49 } # R61 阿非利加—迦太基 49/97
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 62 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref3_africa = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_62 >= 30 } # R62 凯撒毛里塔尼亚 30/60
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 63 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref3_africa = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_63 >= 35 } # R63 廷吉塔纳毛里塔尼亚 35/70
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 64 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_iberia_core = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_64 >= 36 } # R64 贝提卡—斯帕尼亚 36/72
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 65 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_iberia = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_65 >= 50 } # R65 塔拉科嫩西斯—巴利阿里 50/99
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 66 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_iberia = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_66 >= 50 } # R66 迦太基尼西斯—托莱图姆 50/99
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 67 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_iberia = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_67 >= 31 } # R67 卢西塔尼亚 31/62
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 68 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_iberia = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_68 >= 46 } # R68 加拉埃基亚 46/92
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 69 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_france = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_69 >= 38 } # R69 纳博讷高卢 38/76
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 70 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_france = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_70 >= 58 } # R70 阿基坦高卢 58/115
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 71 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_france = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_71 >= 49 } # R71 卢格敦高卢 49/98
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 72 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_france = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_72 >= 38 } # R72 阿莫里卡—卢格敦西 38/76
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 73 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_france = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_73 >= 60 } # R73 比利时高卢 60/119
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 74 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_britain = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_74 >= 52 } # R74 上不列颠—伦迪尼乌姆 52/104
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 75 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_britain = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_75 >= 35 } # R75 下不列颠—埃博拉库姆 35/70
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 76 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_britain = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_76 >= 30 } # R76 喀里多尼亚—瓦伦提亚 30/60
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 77 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_germany = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_77 >= 37 } # R77 下日耳曼尼亚 37/74
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 78 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_germany = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_78 >= 38 } # R78 上日耳曼尼亚 38/76
        AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 79 owner ?= { oe_theme_unlock_pref4_germany = yes } oe_theme_emp_owned_79 >= 39 } # R79 雷蒂亚二省—温德利西亚 39/77
    }
}

    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
        OR = {
            AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 1 location:constantinople = { OR = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes } } }
            AND = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 2 location:edirne = { OR = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes } } }
